interfaces.name: contact_face
interfaces.why: the end face carrying the +, − (and any data) contacts that the banana contact PCB (clamped by part:microduck-banana-pcb-locker) mates to. No vendor drawing of the NP-F contact face was found (electrical.part.json pinout.why); Pollen's mesh is a box with no contact features. Frame and contact pitch are unmeasured — a physical pack or a plate vendor's drawing settles it.

interfaces.name: cradle_envelope
interfaces.why: MEASURED off cad/part.py (graded PASS, out/refcheck/np-f550/r2: p95 0.80/0.60 mm, bbox delta [-0.11,-0.08,-0.11], 6/6 features): the pack is modelled in Pollen's mesh frame with the bbox centre at the origin — z the 70.7 mm length (terminal end at z=-35.35), x the 38.5 mm width, y the 20.5 mm height (+y the grooved top). The 38.5 x 20.5 x 70.7 mm envelope seats in part:microduck-power-support; the assembly places it by Pollen's MJCF transform, no re-derivation. Contact layout and the NP-F latch/eject mechanics that a real cradle also needs are the contact_face interface's CANNOT DETERMINE, not this envelope's.
